violations.text: No person certified in food safety were present as needed at the time of inspection. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Various items were observed in both hand-washing sinks located behind front counter and self-service area. Observed hand-washing sink in 3-bay sink area blocked by a ladder. PIC removed items from hand-sinks and relocated ladder to a designated area at time of inspection. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the self-service area. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Hot dogs was observed held at (49) degrees Fahrenheit located in lowboy refrigerator. Employee moved hots dogs and other TCS foods to another refrigerator at time of inspection. TCS foods were stored in unit less than 3 hours. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

Lowboy refrigerator located behind front desk area was not in good repair. The lowboy refrigerator was observed in poor repair (not holding adequate ambient temperature). PIC relocated TCS foods to another refrigerator at time of inspection. TCS foods shall not be stored in lowboy until unit is serviced/adjusted and maintains 41 degrees temperature and below. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The non-food contact surfaces of the following have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -bottom shelf of Quick eats unit -underneath and behind equipment located in beverage machine area -racks in milk cooler Non-food contact surfaces shall be cleaned to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The floors in the following area has an accumulation of soil residue and food debris: -dry storage/back stock area -underneath shelfs in aisles -W/I cooler The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 08/20/2026

The ceiling tiles in the (retail) area is in poor repair (several tiles observed stained or with holes). The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 11/20/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2025

Food contact surfaces of the "F'real" machine were observed with an accumulation of food and debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2025
Inspector observed unpackaged donuts in a self service case without a list of ingredients/allergens. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2025

The door to the outside, located in the retail area, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2023
The non-food contact surfaces of the lowboy freezer and counter behind soda machine have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2025
The receptacle in the women's toilet room is lacking a cover. A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. New Violation. Correct By: 06/18/2025

The floors in the walk-in coolers and under retail shelves have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. New Violation. Correct By: 06/04/2025

Soap was not available at the hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Hand-washing sinks must be provided with a supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder, or bar soap. PIC informed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 12/04/2023

The door to the outside, located in the entrance, is not tight-fitting. Outer openings of a food establishment must be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by tight-fitting doors. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 12/27/2023
